messages:
pat: quick catch  the API ref for /v1/translate has two problems: the request example shows \"source_lang\": null and the response example uses \"translation\" (singular) while the actual response is an array `translations`. copying these caused a ruby sdk user to get NoMethodError when calling .first on a string.

mina: ugh. where are the examples? openapi/examples/translate.yaml?

pat: yep that file and the generated quickstart snippets (curl, ruby, node). the OpenAPI request schema marks source_lang as nullable which it isn't; server treats null as missing and falls back to auto-detect, but our SDKs choke if they try to coerce null into a string.

devon: I can take this. plan: change request example to omit source_lang (show two examples: explicit en->fr and auto-detect by omission), update schema to `nullable: false` for source_lang, and fix response example to `translations: [ { text: \"Bonjour\" } ]` and update ruby/node snippets.

mina: add a short migration note: \"If you relied on null for source_lang, omit the field instead or pass \\\"auto\\\" (recommended).\" Also note that response previously documented as single object is now array; clients should iterate.

pat: can we also add a tiny test in docs CI that validates example response shapes against the OpenAPI schema so the singular/array mismatch doesn't slip through again?

devon: yes adding tools/docs/validate_examples to assert example types match schema. will include a ruby snippet that shows safe iteration: `Array(resp.translations).each do |t|` and a Node example using `Array.isArray(...)` defensive check.

mina: nice. please also update the FAQ on translate to explicitly call out auto-detect behavior and example payloads.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5031  updates openapi/examples/translate.yaml, snippets/translate.{rb,js}, adds migration note, and a docs-ci test.

docs-bot: docs-ci started for PR 5031 (:building_construction:)

pat: small nit on the ruby snippet: prefer `translations = Array(response['translations'])` rather than `Array.wrap` to avoid dependency on ActiveSupport in examples.

devon: good catch, fixed and pushed.

docs-bot: docs-ci passed for PR 5031 (:white_check_mark:) https://ci.internal.redwood/5031

mina: reviewing now, lgtm. can we backport the example-only change to the 1.1.x docs branch? a customer on that pinned branch hit this exact issue.

devon: cherry-picked the examples commit to `1.1.x/docs` and pushed. merged main branch after CI green.

pat: thanks all  that should stop the ruby error and make examples consistent across languages.

mina: great, thanks for the quick turnaround :rocket:
